model.name: Graph integrity: resolve/prune dangling UC refs + orphan Methods
model.description: Resolve or prune the graph's pre-existing dangling references and orphan Methods so the traceability graph has ZERO broken edges: every UseCase class / classes[] / method reference resolves to an existing unit, and every Method is owned by a Class that lists it. The measured baseline has 12 dangling UC refs (10 point at a DEAD RbDetailView uuid f2f84ce3 - repoint to the live canonical; 1 at a dead Method fcf6dae1; 1 is a literal 'TODO-...' placeholder string) + 51 orphan Methods. These are PRE-EXISTING debt (not from the R27.2 dedup; measured by verify_r27_2_migration.py). A CI gate (trace:audit:strict) then prevents recurrence.
model.tronQuote: > Derived from robbin-req baseline measurement (verify_r27_2_migration.py); PO ratified 2026-07-01 as a separate scenario-first cleanup req.

discoverySource.measured: 12 dangling UC refs (6 class, 5 classes[], 1 method) + 51 orphan Methods. 0 of 12 intersect the R27.2 dup-collapse set (all point at dead uuids: 10 dead RbDetailView f2f84ce3, 1 dead Method fcf6dae1, 1 literal 'TODO-' placeholder string).

model.crossRefNote: Sibling graph-integrity cleanup to R27.2 (class-dedup) — SEPARATE (0 of 12 dangling intersect the dup-collapse set). Enforced by R24.5 trace:audit:strict as the recurrence gate. Ordering: independent of R27.2; run either order (orphan re-measure after R27.2 may reduce the 51 since dedup repoints some methods).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every UseCase class / classes[] / method reference resolves to an existing unit - 0 dangling UC refs.

Every Method unit is owned by a Class that lists it in methods[] - 0 UNINTENTIONAL orphan Methods. A Method carrying an explicit orphanByDesign marker whose impl has NO sourceFile is legitimately exempt (design-stage); that exempt set is currently EMPTY (all 51 have real source).

The 12 dangling are repaired: the 10 refs at the DEAD f2f84ce3-bbbc-4bf7-9345-6a9d4dc64fb5 are repointed to the LIVE canonical RbDetailView f2f84ce3-6f8f-4db1-9ab7-dbcfe8d3bc07 (PO-ratified canonical; it holds those UCs methods by name); the dead Method ref fcf6dae1-69c7 + the literal string TODO-server-class are triaged (repoint OR remove) with a reason.

All 51 orphan Methods attach to their name-derived Class (resolver: live ownerIor Class -> UC.class of a using UC -> R27.2-canonical). All 51 carry impls with REAL sourceFiles, so 0 prune (deletes nothing). The 37 STALE orphanByDesign markers (marker asserts no-source but the impl HAS a sourceFile) are CLEARED as part of the repair. Dry-run+count FIRST; distinct Impl 431==431 (nothing deleted).

trace:audit:strict (R24.5) FAILS on: (a) any dangling UC ref; (b) any UNINTENTIONAL orphan Method; (c) a LYING orphanByDesign marker - asserts no-source but a real sourceFile EXISTS (self-honest marker, prevents future stale exemptions by construction, same spirit as R27.2 reuse-on-wire). Attach-on-wire AUTO-CLEARS orphanByDesign when source appears. Exemption is MARKER-KEYED: only an explicit orphanByDesign marker whose impl has NO sourceFile is exempt.
Post-cleanup re-measure: 0 dangling UC refs, 0 orphan Methods.
